historical_progress.actual_results_as_recorded: TD2T旧128原子S0端点图与378个正频率已审，最低5.1761cm⁻¹；Gaussian微小力接受但最大位移阈值未过。复用后5S/5T原生SOC完成，S1=2.142275eV、f=0.76363396；S1/T1 SOC在0.01cm⁻¹打印精度为零，不能当物理精确零。完整三模型矩阵未完成。

applicability: 可复用经审计的 TD2T 基态及部分 SOC；三布局激发态弛豫与方法稳健性未完整，不强制先算齐再开发。
reference_gap: No new fixed-torsion, conformer, SOC or adiabatic reference matrix has been calculated.; Resolve basis shorthand explicitly and calibrate CT-state/method uncertainty.
